messages:
Maya: Kickoff  short thread. Need a concise benchmark narrative for next Tue webinar: tradeoffs between tail latency and token spend across three customer workloads. Outputs: 1 one-pager, 3 visuals, 2 social variants, and inbound routing spec. Who takes what?
Ravi: Ill pull the telemetry and produce CSVs. Visuals idea: A) stacked waterfall (P50/P90/P99) by model family; B) tokens->cost Sankey showing baseline vs batching+cache; C) tiny decision chart: choose model variant by SLO and $/k tokens.
Priya: Messaging: no absolute speed claims. Test hero: "Balance latency risk with token spend  a practical playbook for engineers." Use "typical workloads" disclaimers.
Jo: Ill do slides and social crops. Horizontal triptych so it doubles as slide + social card. Palette: evergreen + amber accents. Will add micro-annotations: "batching", "prefix cache", "routing".
OpsBot: Routing suggestion: tag leads by intent and signal. Rules: if (webinar_attend OR api_key_created) AND technical_score>=60 -> AE queue; if engagement_only -> nurture drip + playbook PDF; trial_signup -> product walkthrough. Use UTMs: utm_campaign=inference_playbook&utm_seg={seg}.
Ravi: Sample pseudo query for waterfall (will share CSVs):
```
SELECT model, workload, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99
FROM requests_30d
GROUP BY model, workload;
```
Ill include per-workload sample sizes and methodology for legal.
Priya: Two social variants: engineer-focused (short): "See real workload benchmarks  latency vs token economics. Tue 11am PT. Register:" business-focused (longer): "A playbook to reduce inference spend without exposing users to tail latency  live demo + benchmarks." 20-word blurb for reg page: "Practical benchmarks and tactics to lower inference costs while keeping latency SLOs intact  real workloads, routing, and playbook."
Maya: Timeline: Ravi data by EOD today, Jo mocks by tomorrow AM, Priya copy by tomorrow EOD, OpsBot routing doc by Friday. Maya will assemble one-pager Friday for final review. Owners set. Thanks! :rocket:
